task.title: Show a clean board-start failure, and only for the board still being opened
task.description:
Found by the adversarial review of PR #183 ("Show the desktop shell's own message instead of a board laid over it"); both predate that PR and it left them alone.

1. Raw IPC prefix. When a board fails to start, the shell shows "Could not start this board: Error invoking remote method 'project:open': Error: ...". The middle part is Electron's wrapper around a rejected ipcRenderer.invoke, not anything the user needs. Strip it in the renderer's openProject catch (desktop/src/renderer/app.js), or have main reject with a clean message the renderer can show as is.

2. A superseded failure overwrites another project's status. Click project B (slow or failing start), then project C before B settles. When B's open fails, the renderer's openProject catch writes "Could not start this board" into the project view even though C is now the active project, replacing C's "Starting the board for ..." line. Main already ignores a superseded open (PR #183 bumps openGeneration and parks); the renderer should do the same: only write the failure when state.activeProjectId is still the project that failed, as askForIdentity already does.

Cover both with desktop tests in the style of desktop/test/board-park.test.js (which runs main.js against fakes) or the renderer's own harness, and revert-check each.
